## Task Design a templates directory structure for the issue-tracker skill at `/Users/admin/project/agetns-utils/skills/issue-tracker/`, similar to how the obsidian-tech-note skill uses templates. ## Context ### Current issue-tracker skill (SKILL.md) The skill integrates with Plane issue tracker and has 5 phases: 1. Context Loading - loads `.plane-context.json` 2. Issue Discovery - parses branch names for issue IDs 3. Work Tracking - categorizes work (Feature/Bug/Refactor/Maintenance), tracks changes 4. Scope Analysis - groups files by module, proposes sub-tasks 5. Completion - writes HTML comments, updates status It already has an **inline HTML comment template** in SKILL.md for Phase 5: ```html

작업 이력

작업 유형: {{work_type}}

브랜치: {{branch_name}}

변경 요약

{{natural_language_summary}}

변경 통계

  • 변경 파일: {{files_changed}}개
  • 추가: +{{insertions}} / 삭제: -{{deletions}}

변경 파일

    {{#each changed_files}}
  • {{this}}
    • {{/each}}

커밋 이력

    {{#each commits}}
  • {{hash}} {{message}}
    • {{/each}}
``` Work types detected: Feature, Bug, Refactor, Maintenance Module grouping: API, Service, UI, Test, Infrastructure, Database ### obsidian-tech-note skill template pattern - Templates are in `templates/` directory - SKILL.md references templates using markdown links: `[template-name](templates/filename.md)` - Each template has a clear purpose and structured sections - Templates have variable placeholders (using `{{ }}` or Templater syntax) ## Design Requirements 1. Create a `templates/` directory under `skills/issue-tracker/` 2. Create **issue templates** for creating new work items in Plane (Feature, Bug, Refactor, Chore) 3. Create **comment templates** for recording work history as HTML comments in Plane 4. Update SKILL.md to reference these templates with markdown links (like obsidian skill does) ## Design Considerations - Plane API uses HTML for comments (`mcp__plane__create_work_item_comment`) - Plane work item descriptions also support HTML - Templates should use `{{variable}}` placeholder syntax (Handlebars-like, consistent with existing inline template) - Issue templates should include structured description fields relevant to each work type - Comment templates should cover different scenarios (change summary, sub-task proposal, code review request) ## Questions to Answer 1. What issue templates should be created? (feature, bug, refactor, chore - what fields for each?) 2. What comment templates should be created? (change-summary extracted from SKILL.md, plus what else?) 3. How should SKILL.md reference these templates? (table format like obsidian skill?) 4. Should templates be `.html` files or `.md` files with HTML content? Please provide a detailed implementation plan with: - Directory structure - List of template files with their purpose - Template content structure for each file - How SKILL.md should be updated to reference them
